qa.title: Q988 (Nov. 15, 2024)
qa.question: If I have a Delta Cannon in my cemetery, and I summon Tetra, Sapphire Rebel, in what order should I resolve their abilities?
qa.answer: Since both abilities are triggered simultaneously, you may resolve them in any order. However, if there are 4 cards in your EX area, the order in which you decide to resolve them determines which card is put into your EX area. If you decide to resolve Tetra, Sapphire Rebel's Fanfare ability first, you will put a Repair Mode into your EX area. Then, since your EX area is full, you can't put Delta Cannon into your EX area with its automatic ability. Likewise, if you decide to resolve Delta Cannon's automatic ability first, you will put it into your EX area. Then, since your EX area is full, you can't put a Repair Mode into your EX area with Tetra, Sapphire Rebel's Fanfare ability.

qa.title: Q1008 (Nov. 15, 2024)
qa.question: If I have two copies of this spell in my EX area and 5 Natura cards in my cemetery, do I deal 2 damage to each enemy leader at the start of my end phase?
qa.answer: Yes. Each copy's automatic ability will trigger.

qa.title: Q1007 (Nov. 15, 2024)
qa.question: If I have this spell in my EX area and 10 Natura cards in my cemetery, do I deal 2 damage to each enemy leader at the start of my end phase?
qa.answer: Yes. If you have at least 5 Natura cards in your cemetery, you will deal 1 damage. If you have at least 10 Natura cards, you will deal 2, and so on.

qa.title: Q1006 (Nov. 15, 2024)
qa.question: If I have this spell in my EX area and a Star Phoenix in my cemetery, and this spell's automatic ability triggers at the start of my end phase, can I pay 1 play point to summon the Star Phoenix with its activated ability?
qa.answer: No. Resolving an automatic ability is not the same as playing a spell.
